mesoscaleDiscussions.areas: Southwestern Lower Michigan into far northern Indiana
mesoscaleDiscussions.summary: Wind damage potential will increase along the southern/eastern Lake Michigan shore over the next 1-2 hours.

details.label: Areas affected
details.text: Southwestern Lower Michigan into far northern Indiana

details.label: Discussion
details.text: A linear segment is nearing the eastern Lake Michigan shoreline. The most prominent feature within this line is a small mesovortex west of Ottawa County Michigan. While this feature may locally enhance wind damage potential, the airmass ahead of it has struggled to destabilize this afternoon owing to cloud cover. Temperatures far southwest Lower Michigan and northern Indiana are warmer. These locations should have a locally greater wind damage threat given the steeper low-level lapse rates and larger overall buoyancy. Further extensions in area/time of WW 546 may be needed into northwest Indiana given current convective trends.
